utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I’m just getting back from errands—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Ira, I haven’t heard a firm update yet, but I’d like us to get a clear time and list of needed repairs before folks start showing up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense—I'll ask around while I'm out and see if anyone has the confirmed time or a repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I only caught bits of it—what’s the main thing you need for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Main thing is volunteers with basic tools, especially screwdrivers and pliers. If you can spare an hour Saturday, that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—screwdrivers, pliers, and an hour Saturday. I’ll try to swing by, but remind me what time you’re starting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I agree to anything, can you confirm what exactly needs repairing and who’s collecting the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t want to overpromise yet; I need a clear list of broken items and a named person handling collection before we ask anyone for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fair—can you get me that list and the collector’s name before we tell the block anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Cleo—remind me, is the repair drive this weekend, or am I mixing that up with the garden cleanup again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You’ve got it right—the repair drive is this weekend, and the garden cleanup is the one after.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thank you—that saves me from showing up with a rake instead of a toolbox. I’ll try to put a note on my fridge this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—can you remind me what’s already been decided and what still needs help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I don’t think I’ve got the latest details yet, so I’d rather not guess; what I know is we still need to pin down who’s bringing tools and who’s handling sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—before I do anything, let’s confirm the tool list and sign-up plan with whoever’s coordinating. Do you know who has the latest details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late as usual—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—right now we’re sorting donated tools and lining up folks who can do small appliance fixes. If you can jump in, I’d love you on the sign-up table for the first hour so you can help match people with the right repair crew.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, I can take the sign-up table for the first hour and help steer folks to the right crew. Point me to the forms and I’ll get settled in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—how can I pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam—could you help sort the donated tools and keep a list of what needs sharpening or parts? I’ll bring my toolbox and a spare drill set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can handle sorting the tools and keeping the sharpening and parts list. I’ll bring some labels and a clipboard so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Faye, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive; I can help keep track of where supplies and sign-ups are going.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Opal—thank you. I’m trying to line up the volunteer slots around school drop-off and pickup, so a clear supply and sign-up list would really help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll make a simple list with each supply location, who’s bringing what, and the volunteer slots around drop-off and pickup so nothing gets mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard the latest about the repair drive? Folks are starting to bring by lamps, bikes, and even a wobbly old chair already.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that’s wonderful—I hadn’t heard it was already picking up! I’ll spread the word on my block and nudge a few folks to bring anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be perfect, Quinn—tell them to bring things by Saturday morning if they can, and I heard Marta’s nephew might be there helping with bike chains.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, what repairs are we prioritizing for the drive, and who’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not totally sure yet, Mina—I’ve only heard bits and pieces. I can ask around one-on-one and help make a clear list of repair priorities and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, please do that today if you can. Start with the leaky roofs, broken steps, and heaters—then tell me who’s actually available.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—do you know when and where it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet, Vik—I only heard about it from Marisol in passing. I can ask around and let you know once someone confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell—if you hear the confirmed time and place, tell me and I’ll pass it along to the others.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re touching base about the repair drive—are you thinking of helping with sign-ups, tools, or day-of coordination?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help quietly with sign-ups, if that’s useful. I may need to keep my hours a bit limited, but I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be very useful, Uli—thank you. I’ll put you on a shorter sign-up shift and keep it low-key, so it fits your hours.
